messages:
paul: Heads-up: scheduling a small tf apply in the 22:00 UTC change window. It touches module=iam/assume and module=network/peering. Need provider pin and a short rollback plan.

ivy: ack. which provider version are we pinning to?

paul: pin to registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v4.56.1 1 reason: last-known-good before recent kms flag change. Will run staging canary 30m prior.

deploybot: Pin applied: aws->4.56.1 for branch release/2026-07. Staging 2026-07-12T21:30:00Z, Prod 2026-07-12T22:00:00Z. Auto-upgrades paused until 2026-07-13T00:00:00Z.

hassan: Preflight plan (staging) shows one policy update and one attachment add. Use `--refresh=false` for canary plan to speed it up.

ivy: Rollback plan: Plan A: targeted reapply from git tag `pre-release-2026-07-12` using `terraform apply -target=module.iam/assume -auto-approve`. Plan B: if state mismatch, restore state snapshot and apply from that commit. Avoid state rm.

sre-bot: SRE will watch `iam.assume_error_rate` and `peering.route_drop_rate`. Abort if either >0.05 over 5m window. On abort, deploybot will pin to previous provider v4.55.2 and run rollback steps.

paul: I'll be primary on-call, ivy backup. I'll post an ops message 20m before staging canary with links and the state snapshot location. End.
